login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your username or email address
login.trust: Only enter your password on sites you trust.
login.emailCodeHint: If the server emailed you a code

signup.title: Create an account
signup.subtitle: Choose a username and password
signup.forClient: Create an account to connect to this application. You will review permissions before connecting.
signup.handleHint: Your full handle, for example alice{{domain}}
signup.keepPassword: Keep your password. Creating an account switches this browser to the new account.
signup.customDomain: Using your own domain? Reserve your DID first, then configure DNS.
signup.reservationDns: Add a DNS TXT record at {{name}} with the value {{value}}, or serve your DID as plain text at {{url}}.
signup.reservationNext: Then create your account below with the same details.

authorize.title: Authorize
authorize.subtitle: Grant access to your account
authorize.learnsDid: This application will learn your account DID. Choose any additional permissions below.
authorize.revokeNote: Signing out of this browser revokes access granted through this sign-in.
authorize.manage: Manage account or sign out to use another account
authorize.setNote: This set can change over time within its namespace. You can revoke this application from your account.

sessions.title: Connected applications
sessions.signOutAll: Sign out and disconnect applications authorized in this browser

security.title: Account security
security.subtitle: Two-factor authentication
security.pending: Finish setup to turn on two-factor authentication.
security.secret: Scan this in your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
security.recoveryCodes: Save these recovery codes. Each one works once.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.name: Passkey name
passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys are unavailable in this browser. Use your password to sign in.

errors.invalid_credentials: Sign-in failed. Check your username or email address and password.
errors.totp_required: Enter the current six-digit code from your authenticator app, or an unused recovery code.
errors.totp_rate_limited: Too many authenticator attempts. Try again in five minutes.
errors.auth_factor_required: Check your email for a sign-in code, then enter it with your password.
errors.signup_disabled: Account creation is disabled on this server.
errors.signup_failed: Account creation failed. Check your username, email, password and invitation.
errors.signup_unconfirmed: Registration could not be confirmed. Retry with the same details.
errors.reservation_unavailable: New custom-domain reservations are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.signup_request_invalid: This account-creation request is invalid or expired. Restart signup in the application.
errors.authorize_request_invalid: This authorization request is invalid or expired. Restart sign-in in the application.
errors.authorize_failed: Authorization could not complete. Check the selected account and permissions, or restart sign-in in the application.
errors.authorize_account_mismatch: This request is for a different account or has expired. Sign out to choose the requested account.
errors.account_inactive: This account cannot authorize applications while inactive.
errors.storage_unavailable: Account storage is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.signout_failed: Sign-out could not complete. Try again later.
errors.passkey_failed: The passkey request was cancelled or could not complete. Try again, or use your password.
errors.passkey_exists: This passkey is already registered. Use another authenticator or return to your account.
errors.account_created_expired: Your account was created, but the application's request expired. Restart sign-in in the application with your new account.
errors.totp_enrollment_expired: Setup expired or your password changed. Start setup again.
errors.totp_failed: The request failed. Check your code and try again.
errors.passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.passkeys_disabled: Passkey setup and sign-in are disabled. You can still use your password.
errors.passkey_limit: You can have up to ten passkeys. Remove one before adding another.

forgot.sent: If that address has an account here, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.failed: The reset request could not be sent. Try again.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.failed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

confirm.title: Confirm email
confirm.subtitle: One click confirms the address this message was sent to.
confirm.failed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new confirmation email from your account page.
